generated.prop: tall filing cabinet with no labels
generated.details: Its closed stacked drawers have folded steel fronts and recessed pulls, without labels.
Above the printer in the far upper-center plane, a framed cork pinboard holds unlabeled paper color blocks under small pins.
On the mid-right tabletop beside the printer, three palm-sized unlabelled finish samples lie flat, with exposed wood, laminate and stone edges.
At far left against the wall, a floor plant has leafy stems rooted in soil inside a broad ceramic pot.
